bangkok-thailand-mae-hong-son-fly-ride-r.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: This High point near Krathum Baen → Near Bang Yai stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

Scenic stretch near Pathum Thani → Photo stop near Khlong Luang is the technical section. Hairpins, gradients and mixed traffic can stack up quickly; use low drama inputs, stay wide of centre lines and expect buses or riders appearing exactly where optimism says they will not.

sections.to: Near Bang Pakong, on the way back
sections.advice: Photo stop near Khlong Luang → Near Bang Pakong, on the way back can flow quickly, but only if you keep village limits and junction sightlines sacred. Fast connectors are where rides get untidy when fatigue creeps in.
